title: Common Anti-Patterns
summary: Structure agent systems, integrate them into the SDLC, define the planning/execution boundary, configure observability, and right-size human oversight.

rows: Agent plans AND acts in the same step — no validation window
Agent outputs a plan artifact → validation gate → then acts
Agent pushes directly to main without a PR
Agent commits to a copilot/ branch → opens PR → human reviews
No success criteria — team can't evaluate output quality
Define expected outputs, constraints, and evaluation signals BEFORE deployment
Every action requires human approval (approval theater)
Gates only where human judgment materially reduces risk

blocks.text: **Remember:** Anti-patterns are architectural design failures, not tool errors. The exam asks you to identify the structural mistake.
